name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's conditional "if you pick up the key, you must also open the door" has no timing cue, so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the right template. The "must" makes it hard, and the arguments are in the required order. No goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning and the empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: If the agent picks up the key (has_door_key ever holds), the agent must also open the door (door_open must hold at some point, before, with, or after the key).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
